Weekday notice for a mixed season
Please take a moment

Travel Notice for Companion Animals

Travelers must review animal arrangements before check-in so the Companion Animal Travel Desk can confirm the correct care and boarding path. Staff record each service change in the ledger and share practical instructions with the crews. Travelers who arrive with concern should speak with the desk at once so the record stays clear and the trip remains orderly.

For calm handling, please keep carriers closed until the attendant asks for them to be opened. Personal items, feeding notes, and comfort aids should be kept ready and easy to present. <<FACT F019>> The desk will place the note with the travel file so staff can follow the listed plan without delay.

Bird travel and larger animal service also need careful review before departure. <<FACT F077>> <<FACT F057>> Care plans account for species, temperament, and comfort, and the desk may ask for further details if the animal needs special attention. Please prepare clean documents and follow the instructions given by the attendant.

For any update, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
